verses.original: וְשָׂרַי֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת אַבְרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָלְדָ֖ה ל֑וֹ וְלָ֛הּ שִׁפְחָ֥ה מִצְרִ֖ית וּשְׁמָ֥הּ הָגָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·ray ’ê·šeṯ ’aḇ·rām lō yā·lə·ḏāh lōw wə·lāh šip̄·ḥāh miṣ·rîṯ ū·šə·māh hā·ḡār
verses.literal: Now Abram’s wife Sarai had borne him no children but she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar
verses.literalPt: ORA Sarai, mulher de Abrão, não lhe dava filhos, e ele tinha uma serva egípcia, cujo nome era Agar.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר שָׂרַ֜י אֶל־ אַבְרָ֗ם הִנֵּה־ נָ֞א עֲצָרַ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ מִלֶּ֔דֶת בֹּא־ נָא֙ אֶל־ שִׁפְחָתִ֔י אוּלַ֥י אִבָּנֶ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נָּה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע אַבְרָ֖ם לְק֥וֹל שָׂרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer śā·ray ’el- ’aḇ·rām hin·nêh- nā ‘ă·ṣā·ra·nî Yah·weh mil·le·ḏeṯ bō- nā ’el- šip̄·ḥā·ṯî ’ū·lay ’ib·bā·neh mim·mɛn·nå̄h way·yiš·ma‘ ’aḇ·rām lə·qō·wl śā·rāy
verses.literal: So Sarai said to Abram Look now the LORD has prevented me from bearing children Please go to my maidservant perhaps I can build a family by her And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai
verses.literalPt: E disse Sarai a Abrão: Eis que o SENHOR me tem impedido de dar à luz; toma, pois, a minha serva; porventura terei filhos dela. E ouviu Abrão a voz de Sarai.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֞ח שָׂרַ֣י אֵֽשֶׁת־ אַבְרָ֗ם אֶת־ הָגָ֤ר הַמִּצְרִית֙ שִׁפְחָתָ֔הּ מִקֵּץ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים לְשֶׁ֥בֶת אַבְרָ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַתִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛הּ לְאַבְרָ֥ם אִישָׁ֖הּ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ śā·ray ’ê·šeṯ- ’aḇ·rām ’eṯ- hā·ḡār ham·miṣ·rîṯ šip̄·ḥā·ṯāh miq·qêṣ ‘e·śer šā·nîm lə·še·ḇeṯ ’aḇ·rām bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an wat·tit·tên ’ō·ṯāh lə·’aḇ·rām ’î·šāh lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: So after he had lived in Canaan for ten years his wife Sarai took her Egyptian maidservant Hagar and gave her to Abram to be his wife
verses.literalPt: Assim tomou Sarai, mulher de Abrão, a Agar egípcia, sua serva, e deu-a por mulher a Abrão seu marido, ao fim de dez anos que Abrão habitara na terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ הָגָ֖ר וַתַּ֑הַר וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וַתֵּקַ֥ל גְּבִרְתָּ֖הּ בְּעֵינֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·ḡār wat·ta·har wat·tê·re kî hā·rā·ṯāh wat·tê·qal gə·ḇir·tāh bə·‘ê·ne·hā
verses.literal: And he slept with . . . Hagar and she conceived But when Hagar realized that she was pregnant she began to despise . . . her mistress
verses.literalPt: E ele possuiu a Agar, e ela concebeu; e vendo ela que concebera, foi sua senhora desprezada aos seus olhos.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר שָׂרַ֣י אֶל־ אַבְרָם֮ חֲמָסִ֣י עָלֶיךָ֒ אָנֹכִ֗י נָתַ֤תִּי שִׁפְחָתִי֙ בְּחֵיקֶ֔ךָ וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וָאֵקַ֖ל בְּעֵינֶ֑יהָ יִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽיׄךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer śā·ray ’el- ’aḇ·rām ḥă·mā·sî ‘ā·le·ḵā ’ā·nō·ḵî nā·ṯat·tî šip̄·ḥā·ṯî bə·ḥê·qe·ḵā wat·tê·re kî hā·rā·ṯāh wā·’ê·qal bə·‘ê·ne·hā yiš·pōṭ Yah·weh bê·nî ū·ḇē·nɛ·ḵå̄
verses.literal: Then Sarai said to Abram May the wrong done to me be upon you I delivered my servant into your arms and ever since she saw that she was pregnant she has treated me with contempt . . . May the LORD judge between you and me . . .
verses.literalPt: Então disse Sarai a Abrão: Meu agravo seja sobre ti; minha serva pus eu em teu regaço; vendo ela agora que concebeu, sou menosprezada aos seus olhos; o SENHOR julgue entre mim e ti.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָ֜ם אֶל־ שָׂרַ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה שִׁפְחָתֵךְ֙ בְּיָדֵ֔ךְ עֲשִׂי־ לָ֖הּ הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינָ֑יִךְ וַתְּעַנֶּ֣הָ שָׂרַ֔י וַתִּבְרַ֖ח מִפָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·rām ’el- śā·ray hin·nêh šip̄·ḥā·ṯêḵ bə·yā·ḏêḵ ‘ă·śî- lāh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nā·yiḵ wat·tə·‘an·ne·hā śā·ray wat·tiḇ·raḥ mip·pā·ne·hā
verses.literal: Here said Abram - your servant is in your hands Do whatever you want with her Then Sarai treated Hagar so harshly that she fled from her
verses.literalPt: E disse Abrão a Sarai: Eis que tua serva está na tua mão; faze-lhe o que bom é aos teus olhos. E afligiu-a Sarai, e ela fugiu de sua face.

verses.original: וַֽיִּמְצָאָ֞הּ מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ עֵ֥ין הַמַּ֖יִם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר עַל־ הָעַ֖יִן בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·ṣā·’āh mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ‘al- ‘ên ham·ma·yim bam·miḏ·bār ‘al- hā·‘a·yin bə·ḏe·reḵ šūr
verses.literal: Now the angel of the LORD found Hagar by a spring of water in the desert . . . the spring along the road to Shur
verses.literalPt: E o anjo do SENHOR a achou junto a uma fonte de água no deserto, junto à fonte no caminho de Sur.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר הָגָ֞ר שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרַ֛י אֵֽי־ מִזֶּ֥ה בָ֖את וְאָ֣נָה תֵלֵ֑כִי וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מִפְּנֵי֙ שָׂרַ֣י גְּבִרְתִּ֔י אָנֹכִ֖י בֹּרַֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar hā·ḡār šip̄·ḥaṯ śā·ray ’ê- miz·zeh ḇāṯ wə·’ā·nāh ṯê·lê·ḵî wat·tō·mer mip·pə·nê śā·ray gə·ḇir·tî ’ā·nō·ḵî bō·ra·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: Hagar servant of Sarai he said where . . . have you come from and where are you going I am running away from my mistress Sarai she replied
verses.literalPt: E disse: Agar, serva de Sarai, donde vens, e para onde vais? E ela disse: Venho fugida da face de Sarai minha senhora.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה שׁ֖וּבִי אֶל־ גְּבִרְתֵּ֑ךְ וְהִתְעַנִּ֖י תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh mal·’aḵ Yah·weh šū·ḇî ’el- gə·ḇir·têḵ wə·hiṯ·‘an·nî ta·ḥaṯ yā·ḏe·hā
verses.literal: So the angel of the LORD told her Return to your mistress and submit to her authority . . .
verses.literalPt: Então lhe disse o anjo do SENHOR: Torna-te para tua senhora, e humilha-te debaixo de suas mãos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה הַרְבָּ֥ה אַרְבֶּ֖ה אֶת־ זַרְעֵ֑ךְ וְלֹ֥א יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh mal·’aḵ Yah·weh har·bāh ’ar·beh ’eṯ- zar·‘êḵ wə·lō yis·sā·p̄êr mê·rōḇ
verses.literal: Then the angel . . . added I will greatly multiply . . . your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe mais o anjo do SENHOR: Multiplicarei sobremaneira a tua descendência, que não será contada, por numerosa que será.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה הִנָּ֥ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְקָרָ֤את שְׁמוֹ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ עָנְיֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh mal·’aḵ Yah·weh hin·nāḵ hā·rāh wə·yō·laḏt bên wə·qā·rāṯ šə·mōw yiš·mā·‘êl kî- šā·ma‘ Yah·weh ’el- ‘ā·nə·yêḵ
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD proceeded . . . Behold you have conceived and will bear a son And you shall name him . . . Ishmael for the LORD . . . has heard your cry of affliction
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe também o anjo do SENHOR: Eis que concebeste, e darás à luz um filho, e chamarás o seu nome Ismael; porquanto o SENHOR ouviu a tua aflição.

verses.original: וְה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ פֶּ֣רֶא אָדָ֔ם יָד֣וֹ בַכֹּ֔ל וְיַ֥ד כֹּ֖ל בּ֑וֹ וְעַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ אֶחָ֖יו יִשְׁכֹּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yih·yeh pe·re ’ā·ḏām yā·ḏōw ḇak·kōl wə·yaḏ kōl bōw wə·‘al- pə·nê ḵāl ’e·ḥāw yiš·kōn
verses.literal: He will be a wild donkey of a man and his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him he will live in hostility toward all his brothers
verses.literalPt: E ele será homem feroz, e a sua mão será contra todos, e a mão de todos contra ele; e habitará diante da face de todos os seus irmãos.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־ יְהוָה֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל רֳאִ֑י כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֗ה הֲגַ֥ם הֲלֹ֛ם רָאִ֖יתִי אַחֲרֵ֥י רֹאִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā šêm- Yah·weh had·dō·ḇêr ’ê·le·hā ’at·tāh ’êl ro·’î kî ’ā·mə·rāh hă·ḡam hă·lōm rā·’î·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rê rō·’î
verses.literal: So Hagar gave this name to the LORD who had spoken to her You are the God who sees me for she said Here I have seen . . . the One who sees me
verses.literalPt: E ela chamou o nome do SENHOR, que com ela falava: Tu és Deus que me vê; porque disse: Não olhei eu também para aquele que me vê?

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ קָרָ֣א לַבְּאֵ֔ר בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י הִנֵּ֥ה בֵין־ קָדֵ֖שׁ וּבֵ֥ין בָּֽרֶד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên qā·rā lab·bə·’êr bə·’êr la·ḥay rō·’î hin·nêh ḇên- qā·ḏêš ū·ḇên bā·reḏ
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the well was called Beer-lahai-roi It is located between Kadesh . . . and Bered
verses.literalPt: Por isso se chama aquele poço de Beer-Laai-Rói; eis que está entre Cades e Berede.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֧לֶד הָגָ֛ר לְאַבְרָ֖ם בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֨א אַבְרָ֧ם שֶׁם־ בְּנ֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ יָלְדָ֥ה הָגָ֖ר יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ hā·ḡār lə·’aḇ·rām bên way·yiq·rā ’aḇ·rām šem- bə·nōw ’ă·šer- yā·lə·ḏāh hā·ḡār yiš·mā·‘êl
verses.literal: And Hagar bore Abram a son and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne
verses.literalPt: E Agar deu à luz um filho a Abrão; e Abrão chamou o nome do seu filho que Agar tivera, Ismael.

verses.original: וְאַבְרָ֕ם בֶּן־ שְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים בְּלֶֽדֶת־ הָגָ֥ר אֶת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל לְאַבְרָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rām ben- šə·mō·nîm šā·nāh wə·šêš šā·nîm bə·le·ḏeṯ- hā·ḡār ’eṯ- yiš·mā·‘êl lə·’aḇ·rām
verses.literal: Abram was eighty-six . . . years old . . . when Hagar bore Ishmael to him
verses.literalPt: E era Abrão da idade de oitenta e seis anos, quando Agar deu à luz Ismael.
